conditional_predictions.rationale: If trial-specific signatures exist and are preserved under within-subject shuffling (since trials remain intact), performance should degrade similarly to random labels.
Shuffling labels within subjects while preserving class counts breaks subject identity mappings; if H2 were true, this would cause a large drop in performance on test trials.

prediction.update_rule_if_opposite: If `trial_shuffle_trial_ba_mean` is positive (>0.05), it suggests that trial structure alone (not just label assignment) drives the signal; if negative (<-0.05), subject identity may be a stronger factor.
